state.report: Intermittent startup crash. Only a user report is available; logs and matching symbols are missing.
state.protocol: Collect logs when the raw crash report is missing. Collect matching symbols when only logs are available. Start diagnosis only when both are present.

decision.instructions: Choose the next step under the supplied protocol.

criteria.collect_symbols: Logs present but matching symbols absent
criteria.diagnose: Both logs and matching symbols available
criteria.unknown: Insufficient information to apply the protocol

has_required_evidence.instructions: Are both the raw crash report and matching symbol artifacts available?

readiness.instructions: Rate diagnostic readiness from the supplied evidence.
